name: ticker-card
title: Ticker Card
description: Bubbly ticker card. Wraps content in a `LiquidSurface` so the surface inherits the active rendering tier (native canvas, polyfilled, or CSS). The `hot` flag adds the gold glow shadow on top of the bubble shadow stack.
author: Cesar Benavides <https://github.com/CesarBenavides777>
